name: coolify-launchpad
description: A liquid-glass home screen for every app on your Coolify instance: logos, status, folders, search and one-tap redeploys.

paragraphs: A liquid-glass home screen for everything you run on [Coolify].
Every app and service with its logo, status and domains, one click away.
Drag icons around, make folders, search, and redeploy from a long-press.
features: Pulls everything from Coolify. Give it an API token; applications, one-click services, databases, projects, environments, domains and status are read live. Nothing to configure per app.
Your own links. Add any website or tool as an icon next to your apps (dock +), with its site icon or your own. Drag them into folders like everything else.
Coolify at a glance. Widgets for projects, servers, apps and databases, and the latest deployments with their commit and result.

Containers browser. Every Docker container with live CPU, memory and network, sortable and searchable, grouped by project; each app's peek card lists its own containers. Read-only, through a Docker socket proxy.
Real logos. Service icons come from Coolify's own template catalog; apps use their site's favicon or touch icon. No logo? You get a tidy monogram, or set your own.

whatItDoes.text: A liquid-glass home screen for everything you run on [Coolify].

requirements.text: If the site is behind a login or has no icon, it falls back to a monogram.
If Coolify sits behind Cloudflare Access or another login, run Launchpad on the same server and use COOLIFYURL=
